name: Impractical Jokers
description: This hidden-camera series follows four lifelong friends -- Brian "Q"' Quinn, James "Murr"' Murray, Joe Gatto and Sal Vulcano -- who take dares to an outrageous level. To find out who is best under pressure, the guys compete in awkward and outrageous hidden-camera hijinks with the loser performing what is deemed to be the most-mortifying challenge yet.

videos.title: Joker's Choice
videos.overview: In this special episode, Joe, Murr, Q, and Sal bring you their favorite moments from the first season. The guys relive their best hidden camera hijinks, offer behind the scenes insight, and reveal the hidden cameras to one unsuspecting victim.

videos.title: Inside Jokes
videos.overview: In this special episode, learn exclusive trivia and behind the scenes details with on-screen joke notes! Did you know that Sal accidentally hit a crew member in the face with a hot dog? Or the story behind Q's brown jacket? Find out who Murr called before his sky diving punishment, and much more!

videos.title: Happy Father's Day
videos.overview: The guys celebrate Father's Day with very special guests: their dads! Joe, Sal, Murr and Q relive the moments when their fathers  appeared on the show, and their dads share embarrassing behind-the-scenes details and unheard stories.

videos.title: Practically Live!
videos.overview: In this special, the Jokers offer a behind-the-scenes look at their stand-up tour and personal lives.

videos.title: Funny 'Cause It Hurts
videos.overview: When it comes to Impractical Jokers, nothing stands out quite like the punishments. In this special episode, the guys look back at the series' best punishments, share new secrets and reveal never-before-seen footage.

videos.title: Anatomy of a Challenge
videos.overview: In this special, the Jokers break down how to succeed in each challenge and how to make each other trip up and lose.

videos.title: Unseen Scenes
videos.overview: In this special episode, the guys show more never-before-seen footage... or in this case, "unseen scenes".

videos.title: FAN-Tastic Countdown
videos.overview: The Jokers count down the most memorable moments of the show, according to their fans.

videos.title: One Night Stand Up
videos.overview: The Jokers tear up the stage in this special at their sold out show in Torrington, CT. It's a mix of stand-up, never-before-seen clips and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage.

videos.title: Impractical Jokers' Joker Bowl: The Pros Weigh In
videos.overview: For the first time ever, host Casey Jost and former NFL players  Bart Scott and Shane Vereen are in the studio giving in-depth analysis of each joker's strategy and execution as well as statistical analysis and review of game-day footage.

videos.title: NCAA March Mardness Showdown
videos.overview: The guys compete bracket style and go head-to-head, pitting their best moments against each other. 16 clips start, but only one will prevail.

videos.overview: For every hilarious moment on Impractical Jokers, there are plenty more that don't make it to air. Now, while on-board the Impractical Jokers cruise, the guys open the vault to share never-before-seen footage.

videos.title: British Invasion
videos.overview: The guys cross the pond and double-cross each other in this hour-long London special, culminating with a pounding punishment in front of thousands of fans.

videos.title: One Night at the Grand
videos.overview: In this special, the Jokers have their usual shenanigans at the Grand Opera House in Wilmington, DE.

videos.title: Fan-tastic Access
videos.overview: Some of the Jokers' funniest moments took place behind the scenes, huddled around a monitor or waiting for a turn to begin; revisit some of the most memorable behind-the-scenes exchanges.

videos.title: A Day in the Life
videos.overview: In this special, a documentary crew gets a behind-the-scenes look at the making of Impractical Jokers. Subjects mentioned include how to place the cameras, the crew's favorite moments and what happens when someone recognizes the Jokers.

videos.title: The Murray Jury
videos.overview: Join Joe, Sal and Q as they serve up some justice - and plenty of laughs - while recapping the past si years of Murr's performance. Watch the best (and worst) moments from this master of distraction

videos.overview: Pull up a chair with Murr, Joe and Q as they see how their pal Sal stacks up after six seasons of hijinks and humiliation. Sal's magical musical interludes, his uncanny charm, and his slick dance moves will crack you up. So tune in!

videos.title: Judging Joe
videos.overview: Sit down with Q, Murr and Sal as they give Joe some feedback six years in the making. Whether it's his wild physical comedy, his world-famous belly or his fearless approach, these classic Joe-ments are sure to make you laugh.

videos.title: Critiquing Q
videos.overview: Join in the fun as the guys take a swing at Q's best and worst moments. Learn why he's the guy's guy of the group, how his shortcuts lead to unexpected results and why his dance moves are memorable for all the wrong reasons.

videos.title: Humiliation for the Holidays

videos.title: Rob Riggle
videos.overview: Murr, Sal, and Q perform a questionable taste test. Later, they work off some of those calories with some Crossfit. Finally, Rob Riggle lets the losing Joker show off that new swole gym body.

videos.title: Chris Jericho
videos.overview: Sal, Q, and Murr slather on the charm for a commercial shoot, before focusing on delivering some hard truths. Finally, Chris Jericho turns heel on the losing joker.

videos.title: Adam Pally & Jon Gabrus
videos.overview: Murr, Sal, and Q learn that a good babysitter can be hard to find, before going off to perform some consumer research. Later, Adam Pally & Jon Gabrus shock the losing joker with their devious punishment.

videos.title: David Cross
videos.overview: Q, Murr, and Sal finally clean out their garages before giving truly spooky presentations. In the end, David Cross brings a sense of danger to the losing Joker, and makes a memory they’re sure to not forget.

videos.title: Method Man
videos.overview: Q, Murr, and Sal get brainy with it when they play mad scientists. Later, they answer for their crimes in the form of a really dumb survey. The losing joker participates in the new talk show REAL TALK WITH METH, led by Method man.

videos.title: Brooke Shields
videos.overview: Sal, Q, and Murr show off the latest fashions for an awestruck crowd, before making a go at finding true love. Ultimately, special guest Brooke Shields shows the losing joker that breaking up is hard to do.

videos.title: Bret Michaels
videos.overview: Sal, Q, and Murr are crashing (and burning) into product displays and hiding in tight spaces, but one of them must face the music with our celebrity guest Bret Michaels.

videos.title: Post Malone
videos.overview: In this week's episode, the Jokers are giving unsolicited etiquette advice, and live taping strange product reviews shortly after. Then, one lucky Joker will be taking all the blame for our celebrity guest, Post Malone!

videos.title: Anthony Davis
videos.overview: From working remotely to pitching unconventional business ideas with Steve Byrne, one Joker has a shot at winning a pair of highly sought-after sneakers thanks to NBA star, Anthony Davis!

videos.title: John Mayer
videos.overview: Joined by John Mayer, the Jokers must convince unsuspecting temps to accompany them to a business dinner. Afterwards, the losing Joker has to face the wrath of angry Mayer fans in a humiliating punishment.

videos.title: Kesha
videos.overview: Sal, Q, and Murr are falling head over heels for someone they just met, and later on in a heated debate with pro wrestler MJF. At the end, one Joker will discover an untapped clairvoyant talent they possess with guest star Kesha!

videos.title: Sideline Smack Talk
videos.overview: A special episode hosted by Casey Jost and former NFL player Eddie Jackson as they spend time reviewing nail-biting clips of never-before-seen moments from Season 10.

videos.title: Paul Scheer
videos.overview: Unable to pull off this week's pickleball and coffee shop challenges, the losing Jokers are forced to participate in an overseas game show hosted by special guest Paul Scheer!

videos.title: Kal Penn
videos.overview: Tonight, the Jokers are posing as salesmen and must sell their bizarre products to focus group participants. Then attempt a challenge that turns out to be a mouthful. Sal finds himself in a "stinky" situation with guest star Kal Penn!

videos.title: Bruce Campbell
videos.overview: The jokers are dishing out as waiters and later grilled by news anchor Rosanna Scotto; finally, the losing joker is in for a horrific treat with guest star Bruce Campbell.

videos.title: Blake Anderson
videos.overview: Sal, and Murr pose as cash-grabby waiters and later as embarrassing parents; after the losing Joker is forced into a far-out focus group punishment with special guest, and so-called Ganja Weasel, Blake Anderson.

videos.title: Bobby Moynihan
videos.overview: Q, Sal, and Murr coax their trainees to secure donations through unusual ways. Then, they’ll discipline their “kids” with the help of fellow shoppers. Later, Murr is running rampage as a “Tailor-zilla” at a bridal shop with guest star Bobby Moynihan!

videos.title: Kim Fields
videos.overview: Q, Murr, and Sal make spectacles of themselves at an after-hours museum event, then try to interest park-goers in their strange pet-themed businesses. Actor Kim Fields helps deliver a punishment that proves context is everything.

videos.title: Paula Abdul
videos.overview: We’ll find out if the Jokers have the chops to make it as film directors, then get kicked to the curb for their inappropriate behavior. Finally, our celebrity guest Paula Abdul will be hosting a dinner for her diehard fans, and Sal will be in attendance... as a diehard pain in the ass.

videos.title: Eric Andre Returns
videos.overview: The Jokers ask random park goers to watch their grandma while they make a quick errand then are interviewed for a fake documentary. The losing Joker will be dressed as a clown and punished by the other Jokers and returning special guest, Eric Andrè.

videos.title: ALF
videos.overview: The Jokers have an over the top reaction to a phone call and offer absurd event tickets to people on the street. The losing Joker is joined with alien Alf, and his planet’s cuisines.

videos.title: Michael Ian Black
videos.overview: Q, Murr, and Sal send awkward text messages to food court patrons at the mall, then go rouge as retail security guards. A punishment courtesy of guest star Micheal Ian Black leaves the loser feeling not so jolly.

videos.title: Harvey Guillen
videos.overview: The Jokers pose as lawyers with ridiculous contracts and then they mean no disrespect yet say disrespectful things to shoppers. The losing Joker is coached by Harvey Guillen on his latest acting method.

videos.title: Joey Fatone
videos.overview: The Jokers are bad receptionists and must do and say what the other guys tell them. Then it's a Joker vs Joker challenge with Joey Fatone, followed by an epic punishment culminated by the Joker's previous punishments.

videos.title: Roy Wood Jr.
videos.overview: Sal, Q, and Murr are put to the test; first as tv producers, then as product inventors, while the losing Joker won't be tooting his own horn - celebrity guest Roy Wood Jr. will!

videos.title: Tournament of Losers
videos.overview: Uh oh! Kicking good people out and stealing from strangers is what's on the agenda for the Jokers this week, with one of them ruining the entire night of a whole sports bar in tonight's big punishment!

videos.title: Cell Block
videos.overview: From bombing job interviews to trashing their Nona's sauce, the Jokers are not on their game this week with one Loser being punished by confronting cellphone users in this nail-biting punishment!

videos.title: Bowling for Dollars
videos.overview: Today the Jokers are snagging tips and spinning the Wheel of Doom to determine who will be the losing Joker, who will be excusing his bad behavior with a very "generous" compensation.

videos.title: The Planetarium Prowler
videos.overview: We're reporting crimes and disrupting mealtimes in this week's challenges, but in the end, one Joker has to shed light onto something (or someone) very important to complete his punishment!

videos.title: Check Yourself
videos.overview: Watch out! The Jokers are back taking offense at baristas and reading unusual product reviews. Later, one Joker will be punished by provoking diners with one difficult task.

videos.title: The F Bomber
videos.overview: It's a busy week for the Jokers as they fake their marriage and interview folks for an upcoming lifestyle article, but one Loser couldn't keep up and will be forced to curse out in tonight's punishment!

videos.title: Personal Be-Wrongings
videos.overview: No sudden movements! The Jokers are hiding from their boss, then (trying) to get away with sending bizarre emails. But ultimately, one loser won't make it through, and is caught red handed messing with women's purses!

videos.title: Shake What Daddy Gave Ya
videos.overview: The Jokers are coming in hot and correcting "rude" behavior in this episode, but not before adding an unusual fee to customers' bills! Sadly, one of them couldn't wrap his mind around winning this week. So instead, he'll have to wrap his legs around something else!

videos.title: One for the Books
videos.overview: This week, the Jokers are raising hell at Raising Cane's and following that asking for help to carry some furniture. At the end, one of them will be strapped to a speeding race car for his punishment… or is it?

videos.title: Bad News Bares
videos.overview: Watch out! Q, Murr and Sal are throwing and catching grocery items in this Joker vs. Joker challenge with our special celebrity guest, Jax! Later, they'll be getting on one knee and professing their love in an awkward proposal. And in tonight's exciting punishment, we're bringing the old phrase to calm the nerves by "picturing the audience naked" to life.

videos.title: When You Gotta Go
videos.overview: Being a parent means you have very little time, which is why the Jokers are bringing their (plastic) newborns to the grocery store! After, they'll be pitching new community programs that the local community will find quite strange. But in the end, one of them couldn't hold it in, so he'll have to let it out ... onto people's cars.

videos.title: Cross the Line
videos.overview: One-star reviews are what Sal, Q and Murr will be combating, and then testing their acting chops with special celebrity guest, Richard Kind! At the end, one of them will be forced to cut the line at a grocery store, over, and over, and over … and over.

videos.title: Bullion Beggar
videos.overview: From being overprotective parents to disclosing perplexing side effects, one Joker couldn't hack it in this episode, and will learn that not all glitters is gold.

videos.title: Hung in There
videos.overview: Looks like the guys are selling sunsets (or struggling to), while later asking for help to film a bizarre video. However, one must lose. And that one must help a horse lose something from down under.

videos.title: Thanks for Nothing
videos.overview: We're scouting for the next child star while trying not to laugh as Dan Jost (a family friend) reads his "honest" movie reviews in a focus group. Sadly, one of them will be crowned this week's loser, and will be forced to bite the hand that feeds him!

videos.title: Lactose Intolerables
videos.overview: It's mayhem as the guys work as mall janitors with an out-of-control trash can, and then devising a plan of revenge on our producer Dan Cast. But in the end, two Jokers lost this episode race, and will be getting the refill of a lifetime.

videos.title: Off the Wheels
videos.overview: Murr, Q and Sal will be sitting alongside a stranger to participate in a documentary-style interview. Then, they'll be trying to upcharge guests again as hotel concierge. At the end, one of them will be working up a sweat as Peloton's biggest nightmare.

videos.title: Trolling for Friends
videos.overview: The Jokers are breaking and entering a home for a commercial where they showcase their wackiest and most over the top performances. To top it off, one loser will be troll-ing his way through the Liberty Science Center's Touch Tunnel.

videos.title: The Endless Esophagus
videos.overview: Sal, Q and Murr kick off another season of antics by getting themselves stuck in a vent system and confusing customers at a bagel shop. Then, our losing Joker will face humiliation in a punishment that's tough to swallow.

videos.title: Call of the Wild
videos.overview: The Jokers are back working as dry cleaners and TV producers, but one of them can't keep it together and must endure concertgoers who have escaped their enclosures.

videos.title: Facial Awareness
videos.overview: The Jokers face off by recording voiceover for a fake video game and playing the concerned parent writing to their kid's school. But one Joker burns out with a punishment that's gotta sting.

videos.title: Customer Disservice
videos.overview: Lights, camera, Fatone! Joey interviews the Jokers for a fake documentary, then the guys react to an overly emotional phone call for an underwhelming reason. One Joker checks out and is forced into being the world's worst grocery store employee in his punishment.

videos.title: Rage Baiter
videos.overview: The Jokers hit the grocery store aisles dressed in absurd disguises, then train someone in using aggressive phone tactics for charity donations. The losing Joker must subject themselves to scientific probing into their hidden emotions.

videos.title: Mind, Body, Swole
videos.overview: The Jokers can't contain the laughs as they answer survey questions for a new snack food and present the world's worst pharmaceutical ads. Then, tonight's loser will work up a sweat in a punishment that's all pain, no gain.

videos.title: Meat Cute
videos.overview: Attention shoppers! The Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store. But tonight's loser must "meat" his fate in a jaw-dropping punishment.

videos.title: Dopamine Denier
videos.overview: And…ACTION! The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial, then make wild assumptions about other mallgoers. But one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

videos.title: Hoop! There It Is!
videos.overview: The Jokers pretend to be med students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight hoping to earn applause. Later, one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.

videos.title: Haunting of the Joker House
videos.overview: The Jokers' "moms" are in town! However, they're helicopter parents meeting the Joker's "girlfriend" for the first time. The Joker must lie to his mom by convincing a stranger to be their girlfriend and agree to join them at a Broadway show.

videos.title: Revenge of the Joker
videos.overview: The Jokers play lawyers trying to convince an unsuspecting focus group to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air.

videos.title: Vac Attack
videos.overview: The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever wacky things the other guys tell them to. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review.

videos.title: Subscribe to Survive
videos.overview: The Jokers are back as wacky inventors pitching a whole new line of AI-themed gadgets. Then, they fill out bogus incident reports with unsuspecting deli customers. The loser will be forced to demonstrate mentally absurd and physically grueling apps.

videos.title: Me, My Selfie and Eye
videos.overview: The Jokers pretend to be bellhops and need to do and say what they're told while assisting unsuspecting guests to their rooms. Then, the guys need to give away tickets to an absurd made-up show they can no longer see.

videos.title: The Founding Joker
videos.overview: The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons. Then, they take a ride through the park. But after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.

videos.title: A Tight Spot
videos.overview: Look out! The Jokers hatch horrible revenge schemes on their office bullies, then put one poor contractor through the ringer as they attempt home improvement projects. Later, tonight's loser will be gifted the world's finest douchemobile.

videos.title: Let's Get Crackin'
videos.overview: The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons. Then, the guys must get a bystander to take their side during a heated argument with their fake spouses.

videos.title: Happily Never After
videos.overview: The Jokers are asking strangers to send an important text to their loved ones, and hunting for their missing kid using crazy descriptions. Then, tonight's loser will say "I do" to facing one of their toughest punishments yet.

videos.title: Meal, Interrupted
videos.overview: Sal, Q, and Murr kick off the season by flagging down a Good Samaritan for help from their broken-down car, then impersonating corpses in a funeral home with Adam Ray. But one Joker can't sit at the table, and will have to clear it too soon.

videos.title: Lean, Mean, Time Machine
videos.overview: Oh no! Sal, Q, and Murr cause havoc by pretending to be terrible office receptionists, then try to convince strangers to join the line for a wacky pop-up event. But one Joker fails his mission and must travel through time to save the future.

videos.title: Celebrity Crushed
videos.overview: The Jokers make mischief by wildly overreacting when a new focus group friend suffers a very minor injustice, then try to impress someone using the cringiest pick-up lines possible. Tonight's loser comes face-to-face with his childhood celebrity crush.

videos.title: Valet Villain
videos.overview: The guys win the world's worst dad awards by surprising their kid with a trip before cruelly taking it away, then they get caught taking crazy notes in a focus group. But one Joker must take the wheel in a punishment that leaves no happy customers.

videos.title: Last Action Zero
videos.overview: The guys put in shifts while getting trained to work the counter at Playa Bowls, then hand out bizarre business cards to people they think could use their services. But one Joker can't complete the task and goes on the defense for his wacky punishment.
